description: What is GEO, or generative engine optimization? A plain B2B guide to getting your website cited in ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI answers, and how to start.

faqs.q: What is GEO in simple words?
faqs.a: GEO, or generative engine optimization, is the work of making your web pages easy for AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews to find, trust and quote when a buyer asks them a question.

No. AI tools mostly pull from pages that search engines can already crawl and rank, so good SEO is the base. GEO adds clear answers, structure and proof on top, so those pages get quoted, not just ranked.

faqs.q: How do I know if AI tools are citing my company?
faqs.a: Write down ten to twenty questions your buyers actually ask, ask them in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google every week, and note whether your brand or pages are named. Track the same list over time.

faqs.q: How long does GEO take to work?
faqs.a: Expect the groundwork in the first month and early citations over the following months, once a cluster of clear pages on your topic is indexed and ranking. Nobody can promise a date, because the AI tools change often.

faqs.q: Can an AI SEO agent do GEO for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Clara AI's SEO agent publishes answer-first posts with FAQs and schema every day, links them into a topic cluster, asks Google to index them and checks a fixed list of buyer questions in AI tools every week.
